prayerExcerpt.en-US: If you would be perfect, go, sell what you have, give to the poor, and follow me, says the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Se queres ser perfeito, vai, vende o que tens e dá o dinheiro aos pobres; depois, segue-me, diz o Senhor.

meta.face: A very old but hale hermit with a TRIANGULAR face: broad weathered brow, very prominent high cheekbones, sunken temples, a narrow pointed chin under the beard; small deep-set eyes narrowed as against the desert sun with deep crow's-feet; a short, broad, slightly flattened nose; a wide thin mouth. Deeply sun-browned skin. The black hood frames the face so no hair shows; a medium-length grey-white beard parted at the chin into two points; bushy white brows; a calm, bright gaze.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual gives him as an old man with a short beard parted in two; the Greek icons, like Damaskinos's, show him hooded. Athanasius says he kept his sight and bodily health to the end; the tau, bell and pig are the Western card attributes.
